summary: Frontend-only e2e validation of Food (Livraison Repas) across 4 actors. Two CRITICAL frontend bugs were blocking the flow; both fixed by me. After fixes, the FULL end-to-end completed: client placed order (POST /api/orders → 200, order_4add3c88774e, total 12.40€), merchant Accept → Start Preparing → Mark Ready, driver Accept livraison → Commande récupérée → Marquer livré, client /order/{id} tracking page rendered with full status timeline including 'Delivered', and admin /admin/store-orders lists the order (id 3c88774e, type food).

ui_bugs.issue: Cash payment radio not persisted to state. Clicking [data-testid="payment-cash"] (RadioGroupItem) leaves formData.payment_method='card' (the initial default). The POST /api/orders body sent payment_method='card' even though Cash was selected. Likely onValueChange on the RadioGroup is not firing for cash, or the value attribute mismatch. Repro: open checkout, click 'Espèces', click Place Order — network payload shows payment_method:'card'.

Playwright page.click('[data-testid="place-order-btn"]', force=True) is silently ignored (no POST, no state change). A direct JS .click() on the same element works. Suggests a pointer-event interception (likely the fixed bottom bar/sticky header overlay with mobile-container max-width centering). End-users on actual mobile should still be able to tap, but the hit-test is brittle. Worth verifying button isn't covered by an invisible sibling.

Currency symbol is $ instead of € across cart, summary, badges. French context but USD signs. Also deliveryFee hard-coded to 2.50 in CheckoutPage instead of using merchant.delivery_fee from /api/merchants/{id}. Customer sees correct figure here by coincidence (backend also returns 2.50).
Badges hard-coded ('$2.50 delivery', '$15 min', '25-35 min', 'Delivering to current location' English placeholder). Should be merchant-driven and FR-localized.

[data-testid="logout-btn"] is outside the viewport on a 430x900 mobile viewport (sits inside a sidebar nav that isn't scrolled into view). Not blocking but Playwright tests must scroll or use scroll-into-view first.

issues: English copy mixed with French (Delivery Address, Order Items, Special Instructions, Order Summary, Subtotal, Delivery Fee, Total, Place Order)

action_items: FIX HIGH: CheckoutPage Cash radio doesn't update formData.payment_method — clicking [data-testid="payment-cash"] still POSTs with 'card'. Audit usePaymentMethods + RadioGroup integration.
VERIFY: place-order-btn hit-testing on mobile — confirm no overlay sibling intercepts pointer events.
POLISH: i18n + currency — switch $ to € and translate Checkout/Food/RestaurantDetail copy to French; use merchant.delivery_fee instead of hard-coded 2.50.
Consider re-running pre-commit lint to catch unknown-eslint-rule references before they reach this preview.
critical_code_review_comments: OrderTracking.js useEffect-before-useCallback was caught by React 18 strict-mode TDZ at runtime, not by lint. Add an eslint rule (no-use-before-define on hooks) and/or move all useCallback declarations above the useEffect that depends on them as a project convention.

DeliveryJobsPage.js: eslint-disable comments must reference rules that actually exist in the project's eslint config — otherwise webpack-dev-server's overlay treats them as fatal compile errors and the entire app becomes unreachable.

CheckoutPage.js places the order via 'demo' fallback even on backend error (sets a fake order_demo_<ts> id). This silently masks server errors and would have masked the cash-radio bug if backend rejected 'card'. Consider showing the real error to the user.
CheckoutPage.js hardcodes deliveryFee=2.50 (constant) — backend authoritative value should be displayed via merchant.delivery_fee or computed quote endpoint, otherwise UI and DB can drift.
OrderTracking.js demo-data fallback inside loadOrder() catch will mask real 401/403/404 from /api/orders/{id}/track and falsely show 'preparing' status to the user.

success_rate.frontend: 85% — full 4-actor e2e completes after two critical fixes; cash-radio + currency/i18n bugs remain

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two critical compile/runtime bugs (DeliveryJobsPage bogus eslint-disable, OrderTracking TDZ) are now fixed in code. The two remaining bugs to retest after main-agent fixes: (1) Cash payment radio on CheckoutPage must persist 'cash' to the POST /api/orders payload (currently sends 'card'); (2) place-order-btn pointer-event interception — re-test with a stock playwright click on a mobile viewport (430x900). Test merchant uses sticky sidebar; logout-btn requires scroll. Driver delivery URL is /chauffeur/livraisons. Admin orders is /admin/store-orders. Currency should be € in FR.
rca of the issue: Bug A (frontend dead): DeliveryJobsPage.js line 54 had `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` referencing an ESLint rule that is not registered in /app/frontend (no such plugin/rule installed). webpack-dev-server treats unknown-rule-in-comment as a compile error and renders a full-screen overlay that intercepts every click — root cause of the iframe 'webpack-dev-server-client-overlay' intercepting login submit. Mitigation: removed the comment. Bug B (client tracking dead): OrderTracking.js used a `useEffect(() => { loadOrder(); connectWebSocket(); ... }, [loadOrder, connectWebSocket])` placed ABOVE the `const loadOrder = useCallback(...)` and `const connectWebSocket = useCallback(...)` declarations. React 18 evaluates the component body top-to-bottom; useEffect's dependency-array references hit the TDZ on first render → ReferenceError → component crashes before mounting. Mitigation: moved the useEffect after both useCallback declarations so the consts are initialized first.
